services.name: Museum Exhibits
services.desc: Take a deeper look into the Battleship Wisconsin with a guided-tour! Our experts will show you areas not open to the public and share the stories of the WisKy. Battleship 101 is a 45-minute, family-friendly guided tour that offers a dynamic overview of the Battleship Wisconsin. Perfect for first-time visitors, this experience highlights key features topside and provides insight into daily life aboard one of the Navy’s last and largest battleships. The tour is wheelchair or stroller accessible. Comfortable walking shoes are highly recommended. Each participant must also purchase an admission ticket to participate in the tour.
